title: Vegan Smoky Kerala Cashews Samosa
description: A smoky, post-workout samosa featuring cashews from Kerala, India, perfect for a diabetic-friendly snack. This recipe combines the crunch of cashews with the warmth of spices, creating a unique flavor profile that is both satisfying and healthy.
instructions: Mix together the roasted cashews, whole wheat flour, ghee or vegan alternative, smoked paprika, garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, and salt in a large bowl until well combined.
Gradually add the water to the mixture and knead for 5-7 minutes until a smooth dough forms.
Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal portions and shape each portion into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 3-4 inches in diameter.
Place 1 tablespoon of the cashew mixture in the center of each circle and brush the edges with a little water.
Fold the circle in half to form a triangle and press the edges to seal the samosa.
Place the samosas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with a little ghee or vegan alternative.
Bake the samosas in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve the samosas hot with a dollop of vegan yogurt (if using) and garnished with chopped cilantro.
Store leftover samosas in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
